incident_note: Workload C ran 14 implementer agents fully parallel on ONE shared git checkout. A repo-wide pre-commit hook auto-staged broadly and concurrent git add/commit/reset calls raced, co-mingling many commits and causing several near-miss incidents (a tracked task file briefly dropped from the index, working-tree edits transiently reverted by a concurrent reset). No content was ultimately lost - every file was independently re-verified post-hoc (grep-based style={{}} counts matched every task report, all CSS brace-balanced, full build/lint/1810-test suite green). Two tests (ConfirmModal.test.tsx, ReviseTool.test.tsx) broke from an earlier task (002) referencing the deleted components.css path - fixed in 51a20b83. Lesson for future parallel ST-3-style batches: use git worktrees per lane, not one shared checkout.
